caption: Post-Night 3 minigame: the 'Fredbear & Friends! 1983' broadcast on the house TV.
Post-Night 5 minigame: the crying child surrounded by his Foxy-masked older brother and three masked friends at the party.
Post-Night 2 minigame: a purple figure fits a Spring Bonnie head onto another person in a back room of the restaurant.
Nightmare (Night 7) ending: the padlocked box — 'Perhaps some things are best left forgotten, for now.'
Post-Night 4 minigame: the child locked in the parts room with Fredbear and Spring Bonnie heads on the shelves.
Rare bedroom variant: an IV drip beside the bed.
FNaF World clock ending: 'The pieces are in place for you.'
Custom Night final walking cutscene: the purple man bent forward, before he brings up a mass of wires and eyes (first frame, 3x nearest-neighbour upscale).
Circus Baby's minigame: the claw extending from Baby's stomach (single frame, 2x upscale).
Real Ending: the silhouette in the mirror opens glowing purple eyes (final frame).
The Fredbear plush's two sprites: without pupils (left) and with tracking white pupils (four frames of the follow animation)

FNaF World's opening screen: 'I will put you back together.' over two white dots. The file name is a misfiling (this is not FNaF4's Night 6), and no record uses the image; see fw-opening-put-you-back-together.png.
The Fredbear plush with its tracking white pupils (FNaF4 minigame sprite)
FNaF World's unused 'ChestOpen' asset: FNaF4's two-latch box, standing open and empty (cannot be triggered in play)
Private Room after the keypad code: the three monitors show a bedroom (top), a hallway with a chair (bottom left) and a bed (bottom right); Fredbear plush at their left. Clock 4 AM, power 42%.
The three Private Room monitor feeds as game textures (2.5x upscale, side by side): bedroom, hallway, bed. Wiki files Private Room-Habitación / -Hallway / -Cama (FNaF 4)-Sister Location.png.
Private Room desk: the Fredbear plush with a grey handset (antenna, keys, speaker grille) in its lap (wiki close-up of the room render, downscaled).
Night 2 Breaker Room panel in game (2x upscale): eight restartable systems ending in Obsv.1 and Obsv.2 (cursor over the last label), and the map with three faint clusters outside the facility.
Breaker Room map texture: the facility in bold outline and three faint clusters (upper left, upper right, lower left), each with one white dot.
Left: the upper-right faint cluster (Obsv.2) of Sister Location's breaker map, 4x. Right: FNaF4's House Map cheat screen (wiki File:FnaF4Map.png). Side-by-side composite of two game textures.
Private Room camera map texture (3x upscale): the office marked YOU, a central vent, two halls and a wide room above.
Extras menu map titled 'Circus Baby's Entertainment & Rental', footer 'Copyright (c) Afton Robotics LLC' (2x upscale).
Rare blueprint screen: Circus Baby (air hose attachment, internal ice cream dispenser, song databank, emergency stop).
Rare blueprint screen: Ballora (audio activation sensor, 'Deter & Misdirect Remote Activation see: Circus Baby dir07').
Rare blueprint screen: Funtime Freddy (proximity sensor/grouping coordination, parental tracking, voice mimic/luring, storage tank).
Rare blueprint screen: Funtime Foxy (light activation sensor, parental voice sync & replay, variable scent release, remote floor anchor).
Custom Night walking cutscenes: first frame of each of the six walk sprites, in order (wiki files AftonWalk1.gif to AftonWalk6.gif).
Golden Freddy V. Hard cutscene: a burnt building with a 'FAZBE… / FRI…' sign and a rabbit-eared figure at the right.
Night 6 cutscene at 'I will put you back together.': the child and the whole Fredbear plush, the other plushies already gone (frame from a gameplay capture).
Post-Night 5 minigame: the child in Fredbear's mouth on the stage, Spring Bonnie beside it, the four masked boys below.
Post-Night 3 minigame: the house's second bedroom (pink bed, flower picture, pink-and-white toy pieces on the floor), the Fredbear plush at its doorway (frame from a gameplay capture).
The four rooms of the minigame house: living room, hallway with grandfather clock, second bedroom, the child's bedroom (four frames from gameplay captures, half size each).
FNaF World first-launch opening: two white dots in the dark, 'I will put you back together.' (official IndieDB screenshot).
FNaF World clock ending: 'We are still your friends. Do you believe that?' over two yellow dots.
FNaF World, fourth clock game: the number 395248 on screen.
FNaF World: 8-bit Fredbear's 'You have to leave breadcrumbs for him, to help him find his way.'
FNaF World fourth-glitch ending: 'My name is Old Man Consequences. Come have a seat, and let's fish for a while.'
FNaF World Update 2: the man at the desk slumped in a dark red pool after the lights return.
FNaF World Update 2 final scene: the man at the desk, 'Her name is Baby.' (frame from a gameplay capture).

Upper left: FNaF4's gameplay Left Hall (wiki File:LeftHall.png), brightened; the white outline marks the area enlarged at right, where a clock with a round pale face is in the dark. Lower left: the minigame hallway with its grandfather clock, the Fredbear plush on top (frame from a gameplay capture, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=36TkKbnWEQA). Composite; the 3D panels are gamma-brightened and noisy.
